premise: Hedgehog wants a hug but his prickles get in the way; Rabbit and Raccoon try a leaf-hug, a tail-hug, and finally a nose-boop that works perfectly.
inspiration: The Porcupine's Dilemma (Schopenhauer's parable), turned for four-year-olds: there is always a way to be close, and friends will invent it.
lesson: There is always a way to show you care.

en-US.title: Hedgehog Wants a Hug
en-US.text: Hedgehog was feeling a bit small today. I would like a hug, he said. Rabbit {rabbit:hop x2} bounced over with his arms wide. Then he stopped. Hedgehog's prickles stuck out every which way. {hedgehog:wobble} Ouch-ish, said Rabbit, not even touching. Hmm. Raccoon {raccoon:pulse} arrived with a big leaf. Leaf hug! They wrapped Hedgehog in the leaf. Crinkle. The prickles {hedgehog:shake 0.4} poked straight through. Hmm. Tail hug! said Rabbit, and turned around and waggled his fluffy tail at Hedgehog's nose. Hedgehog {hedgehog:wobble x2} sneezed. Hmm. Then Raccoon knelt down, very slowly, and leaned in, very carefully, and touched their nose to Hedgehog's nose. Boop. Hedgehog went still. Rabbit leaned in too. Boop. {hedgehog:hearts} {rabbit:hearts} {raccoon:hearts} Three noses, all together, right in the middle of the prickles. Oh, said Hedgehog, in a small round voice. That's the one. {hedgehog:pulse} That's the one.

es-ES.title: Erizo quiere un abrazo
es-ES.text: Erizo se sentía un poco pequeño hoy. Me gustaría un abrazo, dijo. Conejo {rabbit:hop x2} llegó a saltos con los brazos abiertos. Y se paró. Los pinchos de Erizo salían para todos lados. {hedgehog:wobble} Ay, casi, dijo Conejo, sin tocarlo siquiera. Mmm. Mapache {raccoon:pulse} llegó con una hoja grande. ¡Abrazo de hoja! Envolvieron a Erizo en la hoja. Cris, cras. Los pinchos {hedgehog:shake 0.4} la atravesaron. Mmm. ¡Abrazo de cola!, dijo Conejo, se dio la vuelta y le meneó la cola esponjosa en la nariz. Erizo {hedgehog:wobble x2} estornudó. Mmm. Entonces Mapache se agachó, muy despacio, se acercó, con mucho cuidado, y pegó su nariz a la nariz de Erizo. Bup. Erizo se quedó quieto. Conejo se acercó también. Bup. {hedgehog:hearts} {rabbit:hearts} {raccoon:hearts} Tres narices, todas juntas, en medio de los pinchos. Oh, dijo Erizo, con una voz pequeña y redonda. Ese es. {hedgehog:pulse} Ese es el abrazo.
